item.title: Gunsmoke - Treasure of John Walking Fox
item.description: A hunter and his companion are taunted by the bigoted townspeople of Dodge.

item.title: The Waltons - The Heritage
item.description: An offer to buy their land makes the Waltons think about what it would be like to have more money than they need

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - The One with the Gun
item.description: Peter Corman is murdered during a game of poker, and his brother, Lorenzo, arrives in Hawaii for revenge. McGarrett must work out what happened and prevent Lorenzo from carrying out his intentions.

item.title: Matlock - The Cop
item.description: Detective Joe Peters has been accused of taking bribes and murdering a fence; he also is suspected in the death of a fellow cop. Matlock takes the case and finds himself investigating the police force.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Borrowed Baby
item.description: A baby mysteriously appears in Mason's office along with a rare St. Christopher medal, which could help identify the baby's parents.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Uncle Billy's Visit
item.description: June and Ward go away for a couple of days and leave Uncle Billy to stay with Wally and Beaver. Beaver quickly realizes Billy runs a much looser ship than Ward and June and feels as if he can get away with more things. However, he's soon in for a rude awakening when he helps Gilbert sneak into the movies.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Credit Card
item.description: Eddie brags about getting a credit card to his high school friends. When Wally's battery dies on his car, Eddie comes to the rescue by getting him a brand new battery. Everything is fine until Mr. Haskell finds out that Eddie charged it on their charge account.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Trekkin' Series Finale: Land of Lincoln
item.description: Toon In With Me - Trekkin' Series Finale: Land of Lincoln

item.title: Adam-12 - The Grandmothers
item.description: Malloy and Reed are on the lookout for a hype who robbed a hand-made craft store run by elderly women, only to later return the money after robbing an antique store. In the meantime, they engage in a high-speed pursuit, and pull over a priest in possession of marijuana.

item.title: Adam-12 - Million Dollar Buff
item.description: Malloy and Reed have a run-in with a suspected professional jewel thief and fear she will walk due to lack of evidence. They also find themselves in competition with a millionaire vigilante, who provides assistance with apprehending a drunk driver and ending a shootout, but seems destined to soon overstep the law.
